description: Find the FSA food hygiene rating for one or more establishments by (partial) name within a UK city / local authority. Returns each matching real establishment with its 0–5 star rating (or Scotland FHIS Pass / Improvement Required label), address, postcode, business type and last inspection date. Pass the city/council name in `authority` (use list_authorities if unsure) and the restaurant/business name in `name`.

authority.description: City or local-authority name, e.g. "Birmingham", "Manchester", "Glasgow City".

name.description: Establishment name or fragment to search for, e.g. "Pizza Express", "Mehmet".

name: lookup_food_hygiene_rating
title: Look up a food hygiene rating by establishment name
